provenance.paper_title: EMKG: Embodied Memory Knowledge Graphs for Object-Goal Navigation in Dynamic Open Worlds

evidence.section: Publisher method description: Dynamic Memory Knowledge Graph
evidence.paraphrase: Builds an extensible multimodal memory relational knowledge graph.; Fuses image/text embeddings with 3D coordinate representations.; Sampling-based RAG update evaluates top-k candidates and incrementally updates the vector memory.. graph query/traversal over the memory conditioned on the current goal.

evidence.section: Publisher method description: Dynamic Memory Knowledge Graph
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, EMKG applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Object nodes and target captions; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

evidence.section: Publisher method description: Dynamic Memory Knowledge Graph
evidence.paraphrase: During operation, EMKG applies evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence to Object nodes and target captions; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (Publisher pp. 4537–4544): During inference, the operative memory component (Object nodes and target captions) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
